record.name: TheJollyLaMa
record.bio:
Lone wolf, unofficial and untrained web3 developer and artist, multi talented extraordinaire, resident genie in a bottle 
🧞‍♂️
 . 🪔 .

projects.name: DecentCanopy
projects.description: A living map of independent creators, projects and funds, drawn like branches on a tree. Zoom in, follow the lines, and see what connects and where help is needed. Creators sign their own profiles with their wallets, the Artizen graph is kept as a frozen archive, and the whole canopy is pinned to IPFS so it can be opened from anywhere. Every creator also gets a private Rabbit Hole video room to meet collaborators.

projects.name: DecentBusking
projects.description: Drop a track. Join the loop. Mint it when you are ready. DecentBusking is a Web3 digital town square for musicians: a community listening room, a 3D timeline of music NFTs on Base, and JukeLoop, a Discord radio that rotates community uploads. Listen, tip a performer, or bring a track and request an NFT minted straight to your artist wallet.

projects.name: TheGreenTeaParty
projects.description:
Ask not what your Earth can do for you, but what you can do for your Earth.

The Green Tea Party aims to bring artists, builders, and earth guardians together to reclaim and repurpose spaces into creative, locally rooted communities living in better accordance with the environment.

Its growing project family includes DecentCanopy, Green Tea Hut #1, and Mama’s Green Tea Party Kiln—distinct projects connected by shared stewardship, collaboration, and decent(ral) thinking.

Explore connected projects through a fractal map, discover the public ledger, and help turn conversations over tea and coffee into real-world action. Build agency, not attention. 🍵🌱

projects.name: BigNuten
projects.description: Wellness and wealth, open source. BigNuten is a privacy-first health and discipline app: log nutrition, workouts, supplements, mood, pain, breathwork and yoga, back your data up to IPFS, and earn $BNUT tokens on Base. Join StreakBet challenges with real stakes and help govern the platform as a DAO member. No backend, no build step, and open to every kind of contributor.

projects.name: ArtFi
projects.description: A peer-to-peer advance registry and micro-liquidity protocol for Web3 creators. ArtFi lets creators request funding on clear repayment terms and lets other wallets review and fund those requests through on-chain escrow. Its wider network also supports contributor bounties and rewards for qualifying IPFS node operators. Built around transparent requests, offers, settlement records, and community participation.

projects.name: qArt-code
projects.description: Turn a project link into a distinctive, scannable piece of art. qArt-code is a browser-based QR design studio for creators, campaigns, installations, and decentralized applications. Customize patterns, corners, colors, and logos; check contrast and payload density; then export high-resolution PNG or SVG artwork for posters, stickers, websites, and everyday sharing.

projects.name: Green Tea Hut #1
projects.description: The Green Tea Party’s first project: a budget-built superadobe greenhouse created by artists living by the river. Its public accountability ledger follows project funding, spending, milestones, and supporting proof links so donors, collaborators, and neighbors can see how the work develops. A practical experiment in earth building, creative stewardship, and transparent community projects.
